Definition: Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jonathan is the name of four Israelites, and the son of Saul is the best known of them. In 1 Samuel 14:6, Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour. The fuller story is told on the Jonathan, Son of Saul profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jonathan is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
